name: TicketImportDurableJobOrchestration
rules: Worker discovery/security/parsing runs outside domain mutation transactions; only bounded technical staging/publication/checkpoint transitions use short LLD-01 UnitOfWork blocks.
A recovered source-check job must revalidate source stability and exact profile versions before trusting a parser checkpoint.

Fresh PublishStagedImportRun first checkpoints phase=publishing; its publication UoW then consumes assert_claim_current's current checkpoint, which must bind exact import_run_id/run_revision/parser_profile_id/candidate_identity. claim.checkpoint_json is never publication authority.

PublishStagedImportRun enqueue_or_coalesces sr_reappearance_reconcile only for NEW_SOURCE advanced_search_sr in its own publication UnitOfWork; CHRONOLOGY_CONTENT_CONFLICT remains unscheduled while recovery_required and OLDER_SOURCE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED is never automatic reappearance authority.

For an authorized equal-chronology advanced_search_sr correction, FinalizeImportRunReview enqueue_or_coalesces sr_reappearance_reconcile only in the same UnitOfWork that replaces the source checkpoint with that corrected run; rollback leaves neither checkpoint replacement nor runnable job.

The reappearance worker reads only immutable published LLD-04 observation identity evidence and LLD-03 current source-presence state; it never reopens the workbook and never accepts source field values.

Each affected SR warning is resolved by one replay-safe internal command/UnitOfWork; committed replay is resolved before mutable claim reads, while every fresh per-SR execution calls LLD-01 DurableJobCoordinator.assert_claim_current with the exact sr_reappearance_reconcile claim inside that same owner-command UnitOfWork before inserting its command receipt. A cancelled, recovered, completed, failed or replaced claim therefore cannot clear a warning.

The LLD-04 SrSourcePresenceEvidenceProvider independently enforces governed Advanced Search candidate-chronology freshness relative to the active disappearance event; job existence alone is never reappearance authority.
The job never transports an unbounded owner-domain mutation set across packet boundaries.
Unknown job contract versions fail closed and remain inspectable.

JobTypeContract validation callbacks implement the exact closed payload/checkpoint shapes, dedupe derivations, retry schedule and REJECT_NONTERMINAL_PACKET_CONTEXTS_V1 cancellation rules above; handlers may not broaden them dynamically.
A source-check or reappearance job never scans Communications or directly changes SR/RFC/WFM/Task lifecycle.
